crossRefs.note: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”
Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and Yahweh’s glory appeared to all…
Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and…
Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
The Spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.
Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled…
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full…
But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing…
But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from…
seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the…
having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, as if it were a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

parallels.note: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.
The priests could not enter into Yahweh’s house, because Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

translations.web: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud. For the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the glory of Jehovah filled the house of Jehovah.
